# Copy Path Mini

> Tiny Windows right-click path copier for local AI coding workflows. Copy one plain file or folder path into an agent chat; 5,632-byte helper, no resident process and no network calls.

## Project
- [English overview](README.md): installation, platform support, honest limits and source build.
- [简体中文](README.zh-CN.md): Chinese overview.
- [Agent reference](AGENT_GUIDE.md): factual capability map and source pointers.
- [Core source](CopyPath.cs): complete clipboard helper.
- [Installer source](CopyPath.nsi): current-user installation and reversible menu registration.
- [Verification](Verify-Installer.ps1): isolated English and Chinese installer checks.
- [Releases](https://github.com/vx790905119-svg/copy-path-mini/releases/latest): installer and SHA256SUMS.txt.
- [License](LICENSE): MIT; see third-party notices for installer components.
